item.title: Sonoma evacuation study flags chokepoints, shapes future growth and safety plans
item.description: City Council looked at a recent evacuation study of Sonoma's roadways during its Feb. 4 session. City administrators, along with police and fire officials, reviewed the area's potential chokepoints, as well as the sites in need of improvements. They also considered how the city's evacuation routes will impact future development and fire safety.

item.title: Sonoma Valley Unified board to vote on contract with new superintendent
item.description: Possible approval of a contract of more than three years between the Sonoma Valley Unified School District and incoming Superintendent Jason Sutter is among the agenda items for the district’s board of trustees meeting on Thursday, Feb. 12.

item.title: Sonoma Home Winemakers’ speaker series to feature renowned grapevine expert Feb. 12
item.description: Anne Moller-Racke, co-owner and winemaker of Sonoma’s Blue Farm Wines — a leader in making Pinot Noir — will share grapevine selection tips during a free talk on Thursday, Feb. 12, as part of the monthly public education series by the nonprofit Sonoma Home Winemakers.

item.title: Sonoma Valley High’s Lady Dragons close league play in style, look to tourney
item.description: SVHS hosted Napa High Feb. 9 and trounced them 52-4. The win secures the Lady Dragons another home game on Feb.11 likely against American Canyon. The winner of that matchup heads to the league championship on Feb. 13.

item.title: Sonoma Valley Democrats hear from 4th Congressional District incumbent Thompson and his primary challengers
item.description: Mike Thompson, Eric Jones and Trevor Merrell touted their qualifications for the seat Monday, Feb. 9, during an online-only candidates' forum hosted by the regional political organization.

item.title: Sonoma County names Sonoma City Manager David Guhin as next county executive
item.description: David Guhin, the current Sonoma city manager and a former longtime Santa Rosa official, steps into the role with significant local government experience — and little time to get settled in before crafting a challenging budget with the county this spring.
